meta.subject: fix bug in int_div_regfile, so prog22 runs again

en.summary: The fix makes the multicycle integer divider latch request operands and destination selectors instead of rereading transient input ports after the launch cycle.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says a divider bug broke program execution.
The patch updates the divider/register-file RTL state machine, not only tests.
The fix captures request fields into internal state and uses those latched values in later CALC and writeback states.
disqualifiers: Also adds a small test change to expose the transient-input hazard.
evidence: `src/int_div_regfile.sv` adds internal registers for quotient destination, remainder destination, and divisor state.
Later CALC and WRITING states stop reading live `r_quot_sel`, `r_mod_sel`, and `b` inputs and instead use latched internal copies.
The updated test clears `a`, `b`, and the destination selectors right after the request pulse, which would break the old implementation.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A multicycle arithmetic unit must capture every request field that will be needed after the accept cycle. If later calculation or writeback states reread live request wires, a new request or cleared inputs can corrupt the in-flight operation and send results to the wrong destination.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: After a divide request is accepted, the operand bus or destination-select inputs change before calculation and writeback complete.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Use live request inputs during later CALC or WRITE states instead of latched request state.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: bypass request latches for multicycle state machine
portability_notes: This maps directly to any multicycle divider, multiplier, or iterative arithmetic unit with a decoupled request interface.
Capture both payload data and destination tags; corrupting only one recreates only part of the bug.
The failure is easiest to trigger when the request bus is reused immediately for another operation or driven back to zero while the unit is busy.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the handshake point where the multicycle arithmetic unit accepts a request.
Remove or bypass the internal latches that hold operand and destination metadata after acceptance.
In later compute or writeback states, read divisor and destination selectors directly from the external request interface.
If writeback can stall and retry, keep using the live destination tag during retries so a changing bus can redirect the result.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VeriGPU integer divider state machine and register-file writeback bookkeeping
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds internal registers for divisor and quotient/remainder destination selectors, captures them when `req` is accepted, and uses those latched values in CALC and WRITING states.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In commit path `src/int_div_regfile.sv` (later moved in the tree), `internal_r_quot_sel`, `internal_r_mod_sel`, and `internal_b` were added and then used instead of live `r_quot_sel`, `r_mod_sel`, and `b` in later states.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: An in-flight divide can compute with the wrong divisor or write quotient/remainder into the wrong register once request inputs change after launch.
evidence_for_injection: The test was strengthened by zeroing request inputs immediately after acceptance, which directly matches the failure trigger.
The fix spans both compute-time operand use and writeback destination selection, showing the bug is persistent state loss across cycles.
The state machine is fully local to one DUT module, so the reverse mutation is concrete and isolated.
notes: If only one mutation is desired, corrupting destination-tag retention is usually the most visible because it misroutes architected results.
Reverting divisor retention as well best matches the original commit.

zh.summary: 该修复让多周期整数除法器在发起请求时锁存操作数和目标寄存器选择，而不是在后续周期继续读取瞬时输入端口。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确指出除法器缺陷已经破坏了程序执行。
补丁修改的是除法器/寄存器文件 RTL 状态机，而不只是测试。
修复把请求字段锁存到内部状态，并在后续 CALC 和写回状态中使用这些锁存值。
disqualifiers: 同时增加了一个小测试，用来暴露瞬时输入变化带来的风险。
evidence: `src/int_div_regfile.sv` 新增了商目标、余数目标和除数状态的内部寄存器。
后续 CALC 和 WRITING 状态不再读取实时的 `r_quot_sel`、`r_mod_sel`、`b`，而是改用锁存后的内部副本。
更新后的测试在请求脉冲之后立即清零 `a`、`b` 以及目标寄存器选择，这会击穿旧实现。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 多周期算术单元必须在接收请求的那个周期捕获后续仍要使用的全部字段。如果后续计算或写回状态继续读取外部请求总线，那么新请求或输入清零就会破坏仍在执行的操作，并把结果写到错误目标。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 多周期除法器的请求状态保持
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 除法请求被接收后，在计算和写回完成之前，操作数总线或目标寄存器选择发生变化。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在后续 CALC 或 WRITE 状态中重新读取实时请求输入，而不是使用锁存的请求状态。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 绕过多周期状态机中的请求锁存器
portability_notes: 该模式可直接映射到任何带解耦请求接口的多周期除法器、乘法器或迭代算术单元。
应同时考虑载荷数据和目标标签；只破坏其中一个只能重现部分问题。
当请求总线在单元忙碌时很快被复用或清零时，最容易触发该缺陷。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到多周期算术单元接收请求的握手点。
删除或绕过接收后用于保持操作数和目标元数据的内部锁存状态。
在后续计算或写回状态中，改为直接读取外部请求接口上的除数和目标寄存器选择。
如果写回可能停顿并重试，重试时也继续使用实时目标标签，以便总线变化时重定向结果。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VeriGPU 整数除法器状态机与寄存器文件写回记录逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复增加了除数以及商/余数目标寄存器选择的内部寄存器，在 `req` 被接受时锁存这些字段，并在 CALC 与 WRITING 状态中使用锁存值。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在提交中的 `src/int_div_regfile.sv`（后续版本中该文件路径发生过移动）里，新增了 `internal_r_quot_sel`、`internal_r_mod_sel` 和 `internal_b`，并在后续状态中取代了实时的 `r_quot_sel`、`r_mod_sel` 与 `b`。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 除法请求发起后若输入发生变化，正在执行的除法可能使用错误除数，或把商/余数写入错误寄存器。
evidence_for_injection: 测试通过在请求被接收后立即清零输入来强化回归，这与故障触发条件完全一致。
修复同时覆盖了计算阶段的操作数使用和写回阶段的目标选择，说明问题本质是跨周期状态丢失。
该状态机局部集中在单个 DUT 模块中，因此反向变异明确且隔离。
notes: 如果只想做一个最明显的变异，优先破坏目标标签保持，因为它会直接把架构结果写错位置。
同时回退除数保持逻辑则最接近原始提交。
